title: Always-On Analyser
summary: YTIntel analysis no longer stops behind app-level daily limits or surfaces provider credit/quota errors to users. The evidence analyser stays available continuously, with GPT-5.6 Sol used only as an optional cloud enhancement when available.
discord_changes: Removed YTIntel's previous per-IP and global daily AI-call caps from the analyser backend.
Added an always-on evidence engine so Deep Analyse, Pattern Mine and Packaging can continue when the cloud AI provider is unavailable.
Provider credit, billing and quota failures now fall back automatically instead of asking users to add credits or killing the analysis.
changes: Rebuilt ytintel-v082 so YTIntel itself no longer enforces the previous 5-calls-per-IP and 25-calls-global daily AI quotas.
Deep Analyse now attempts the GPT-5.6 Sol enhancement first and automatically falls back to YTIntel's deterministic evidence engine if the cloud model cannot run.
Pattern Mine now has an always-on structured comparison fallback instead of failing when cloud AI is unavailable.
Packaging Lab now has an evidence-grounded always-on package generator that preserves winner/control, originality, risk and falsifier guardrails.
Cloud provider billing, credit, quota, spend-limit, missing-key and availability failures are no longer returned to the user as blocking credit errors.
The UI now labels the feature as Always-On Intelligence rather than implying every result necessarily came from GPT-5.6 Sol.
Cloud GPT-5.6 Sol remains available as an enhancement whenever the configured provider account can serve the request.
Updated the installed PWA cache to v0.20.1 so phone and desktop installs receive the always-on analyser changes.
why_it_matters: The analyser is a core workflow and should not become unusable because a separate cloud-model provider hits a billing or quota issue. v0.20.1 makes YTIntel itself remain operational continuously while still taking advantage of deeper cloud reasoning when it is available.
